title: DOT-04: GAO-25-107166 Recommendation 1 implementation artifact and milestone record
summary: GAO-25-107166 Recommendation 1 remains Open. Its normalized follow-through state is Promised; the record separates the named artifact, visibility, milestone, GAO review state, and remaining gap.
key_findings: Current GAO status: Open; status period: March 2026.

Response artifact: Grants Transparency Dashboard and grant lifecycle system. DOT described systems targeted for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027; GAO said they do not replace the complete information Congress needs now.
Artifact availability: Planned artifacts described on the GAO page.
Named milestone: Second quarter of fiscal year 2027; milestone state: Future monitor.
GAO review state: Recommendation remains unaddressed.
Remaining gap: Complete formula-versus-discretionary obligation and outlay information provided to Congress.

Continuation rule: Recheck for a congressional reporting artifact before or alongside the planned dashboard. Preserve DOT-04 as the parent crosswalk; do not translate an artifact, promise, submission, or GAO review into implementation, closure, or operating outcome.
why_it_matters: Recommendation-specific follow-through makes it possible to distinguish a promise, an available artifact, a submission, GAO review, partial addressing, implementation, closure, and later operating outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves DOT-04 as the parent crosswalk.
Records public artifact availability without treating availability as sufficiency or implementation.
Keeps named dates as monitors that do not pause the active content queue.
evidence_limits: A promised milestone is a monitor, not implementation evidence.
An agency artifact or submission is not implementation unless its scope satisfies the recommendation and the official record supports that conclusion.
Open – Partially Addressed is an official recommendation status, not the Phase 56F Partially Closed entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, or causation.
